title: Add CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
author: moezdil
summary:
Linux Foundation projects are expected to have a code of conduct. This repo is under AAIF, which is an LF project, but has no CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.

Based on Contributor Covenant 2.1, which is the standard across LF projects. Contact address is support@aaif.io.
